webui.ops.dashboard.title: Runtime status
webui.ops.dashboard.description: Data comes from the existing management build, probes, diagnostics, and metrics. No simulated system data is used.
webui.ops.dashboard.refresh.success.deta: The existing management capabilities were read again.
webui.ops.dashboard.refresh.failed.title: Refresh completed with failures
webui.ops.dashboard.refresh.failed.detai: Real results remain visible while failed capabilities keep their current state.
webui.ops.dashboard.availableDetail: All declared management capabilities returned a result.
webui.ops.dashboard.unavailableDetail: A core runtime probe failed. Available results remain visible and failed items are marked.
webui.ops.dashboard.degradedDetail: Successful real results remain visible while failed optional capabilities are marked.
webui.ops.dashboard.requestFailed: This diagnostic is temporarily unavailable. Retry later.
webui.ops.dashboard.loadingDetail: Not all management capabilities have returned yet. Please wait.
webui.ops.dashboard.group.coreDetail: Build, startup, and health probes determine whether the service meets basic runtime conditions.
webui.ops.dashboard.group.optionalDetail: Optional failures keep the page usable while the affected capability is marked Degraded.
